name: Verismo Baroque ~Tsuioku no Utahime~
original_name: ヴェリズモ・バロック～追憶の歌姫～
source:
Francy, a beautiful small town loved by flowers. The Show Theater Baroque in this town, there were a theaters that invited me to a dream. You should be on the stage as a 'Diva' with a unique singing voice. Suddenly a big fire swallows the theater and fills everything with death. You who lose your companion and even your beloved lover and cry.

"Poor Diva, do you want to change your destiny?" In the midst of a tragedy, "Angel of Music" goes back to her destiny in exchange for 'Singing Voice' and 'Memory of Lover' while being guided by her voice whispering softly to you. To find a future to avoid tragedy and reveal their "secret" under the mask.

[From [url=https://www.facebook.com/ikemenfangirl/posts/636512234509988/]Ikémen fangirl[/url] on Facebook]
translation:
Francy是一座被鲜花簇拥的美丽小镇。镇上的Show Theater Baroque是一家令人如痴如醉的剧院，邀你登上舞台，成为拥有独特歌喉的“歌姬”。突然，一场大火吞噬剧院，将死亡带到所有人身边。你失去了同伴，甚至失去了挚爱的恋人，只能悲痛哭泣。

“可怜的歌姬，你想改变命运吗？”悲剧之中，“音乐天使”在她的引导下，轻声对你低语。作为交换，你将失去“歌喉”与“恋人的记忆”，踏上改变命运的道路，寻找避免悲剧发生的未来，并揭开面具之下的“秘密”。

[来源：Facebook上的[url=https://www.facebook.com/ikemenfangirl/posts/636512234509988/]Ikémen fangirl[/url]]
